subject.title: Feature: Support custom anthropic_beta flags in Bedrock model config

question: Should Bedrock expose a broad `additionalModelRequestFields`/`providerFields` passthrough, a narrower typed `anthropicBeta` or `context1m` option, or no user-configurable beta flags?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding any path creates a user-facing provider config contract, and repository policy treats provider routing plus config/default surfaces as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Add Bedrock-owned request fields
options.body: Expose a schema-backed Bedrock plugin or per-model params contract that validates and merges request fields, covering `anthropic_beta` without moving Bedrock payload policy into core.

options.title: Add only typed beta support
options.body: Support a narrow `anthropicBeta` or Bedrock `context1m` path for Claude long-context usage while avoiding a general Converse body passthrough.

options.title: Decline custom betas
options.body: Keep Bedrock request shaping internal and require first-class provider support for each beta feature before OpenClaw sends it.

recommendation.title: Add Bedrock-owned request fields
recommendation.body: Expose a schema-backed Bedrock plugin or per-model params contract that validates and merges request fields, covering `anthropic_beta` without moving Bedrock payload policy into core.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Bedrock provider request-shaping and model-capability history makes this the closest owner for deciding the plugin-side contract shape.
